ambiguous_text: A pulse and a flash must eventually occur.

readings.plain: At least one step has both events.
readings.clear_rewrite: Eventually, a pulse and a flash must occur at the same step.

readings.plain: Each event occurs at least once, possibly at different steps.
readings.clear_rewrite: A pulse must occur at least once, and a flash must occur at least once; their steps may differ.

mechanism_explanation: The eventual occurrence can apply to a combined event or to each event separately.
concerns: The distributive reading may dominate without context. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.

ambiguous_text: Pulses and flashes must keep occurring.

readings.plain: Both events coincide infinitely often.
readings.clear_rewrite: Infinitely many steps must contain both a pulse and a flash.

readings.plain: Each event occurs infinitely often, without required coincidence.
readings.ltl: G F a & G F b
readings.clear_rewrite: Pulses must occur infinitely often and flashes must occur infinitely often; they need not coincide.

mechanism_explanation: Recurrence applies either to joint occurrences or to the two streams separately.
concerns: Keep occurring does not itself clearly suggest coincidence. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.

ambiguous_text: Every request must be followed by a pulse and a flash.

readings.plain: Every request has a strictly later step with both events.
readings.clear_rewrite: After every request, a strictly later step must contain both a pulse and a flash.

readings.plain: Every request has a strictly later pulse and a strictly later flash, possibly at different steps.
readings.ltl: G(c -> (X F a & X F b))
readings.clear_rewrite: After every request, a pulse and a flash must each occur strictly later; their steps may differ.

mechanism_explanation: A request can require a joint response event or two separate responses.
concerns: Followed by may introduce a separate immediacy question; these readings both fix strictly later, with no bound. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.

ambiguous_text: A pulse and a flash must occur before any stop.

readings.plain: A joint occurrence is required before the first stop, if a stop occurs.
readings.clear_rewrite: There must be a step with both a pulse and a flash, and no stop may occur at or before that step.

readings.plain: Each event is required before the first stop, at possibly different steps.
readings.clear_rewrite: A pulse and a flash must each occur at a step preceding every stop; they may occur at different steps, and both are required even if no stop ever occurs.

mechanism_explanation: The events share a deadline but may or may not have to share a step.
concerns: The sentence must retain its positive occurrence requirement when no stop occurs; the joint reading may be weak. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.

ambiguous_text: After each request, a pulse and a flash are required before the next stop.

readings.plain: Starting strictly after each request, both events must coincide before any subsequent stop.
readings.clear_rewrite: For each request, a strictly later step must contain both a pulse and a flash, with no stop from the next step through that response step.

readings.plain: Starting strictly after each request, each event must occur before any subsequent stop, possibly separately.
readings.clear_rewrite: For each request, a pulse and a flash must each occur strictly later, before any subsequent stop; their steps may differ and both remain required if no stop follows.

mechanism_explanation: Each request establishes a new response interval, within which joint or separate fulfillment is possible.
concerns: Next stop may presuppose that a stop occurs; neither formula requires a stop. Overlapping request intervals share responses. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.

ambiguous_text: The signal and the indicator must eventually be active for two consecutive steps.

readings.plain: Both states hold throughout the same pair of consecutive steps.
readings.clear_rewrite: Eventually, the signal and indicator must both be active at one step and both remain active at the next step.

readings.plain: Each state has a pair of consecutive active steps, possibly different pairs.
readings.ltl: F(a & X a) & F(b & X b)
readings.clear_rewrite: The signal must be active for two consecutive steps at least once, and the indicator must also be active for two consecutive steps at least once; the pairs may differ.

mechanism_explanation: The joint event is now a two-step episode, compared with independently located episodes.
concerns: The joint reading may be favored by the shared duration phrase; longer runs also satisfy both readings. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.

ambiguous_text: The signal and the indicator must eventually become active.

readings.plain: At some step both are inactive and at the next both are active.
readings.clear_rewrite: Eventually, a step with both the signal and indicator inactive must be immediately followed by a step with both active.

readings.plain: Each independently changes from inactive to active at least once.
readings.ltl: F(!a & X a) & F(!b & X b)
readings.clear_rewrite: The signal and the indicator must each make an inactive-to-active transition at least once; the transitions may occur at different steps.

mechanism_explanation: Coincidence concerns transition events rather than merely overlapping active states.
concerns: Become active is interpreted as a discrete inactive-to-active transition; an initially active state alone does not satisfy either reading. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.

ambiguous_text: Eventually the signal and the indicator must be active until a release occurs.

readings.plain: A common episode starts with both active and maintains both until a release occurs.
readings.clear_rewrite: Eventually, both the signal and indicator must be active at a common starting step, and both must stay active until a release occurs; a release is required and may occur at that starting step.

readings.plain: Each has its own active episode lasting until a release, possibly different episodes and releases.
readings.ltl: F(a & (a U c)) & F(b & (b U c))
readings.clear_rewrite: The signal must have an active episode lasting until a release, and the indicator must also have such an episode; the episodes and releases may differ, and a release may occur at an episode’s starting step.

mechanism_explanation: The coordinated requirement may demand a common sustained episode or separately witnessed sustained episodes.
concerns: The separate reading is demanding to convey naturally. Present-inclusive strong until allows release at the starting step. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.

ambiguous_text: A pulse and a flash must occur with a completion afterward.

readings.plain: A joint pulse-and-flash step occurs with a strictly later completion.
readings.clear_rewrite: A pulse and a flash must occur at the same step, and a completion must occur at a strictly later step.

readings.plain: Each event occurs with some strictly later completion, possibly separately.
readings.ltl: F(a & X F c) & F(b & X F c)
readings.clear_rewrite: A pulse must occur before a later completion, and a flash must occur before a later completion; the pulse and flash may occur at different steps.

mechanism_explanation: Coincidence is required or relaxed for the events that precede completion, rather than for unrestricted events.
concerns: The sentence may suggest a single completion, but the separate formula still guarantees a completion after both selected events on an infinite linear trace. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.

ambiguous_text: After a start, a pulse and a flash must occur before a finish.

readings.plain: Some start precedes a joint occurrence, which precedes a finish.
readings.ltl: F(c & X F(a & b & X F d))
readings.clear_rewrite: There must be a start, then a strictly later step with both a pulse and a flash, then a strictly later finish.

readings.plain: Some start precedes both events, which may occur separately before a finish.
readings.ltl: F(c & X(F(a & X F d) & F(b & X F d)))
readings.clear_rewrite: There must be a start followed strictly later by a pulse and by a flash, possibly at different steps, with a finish strictly after both events.

mechanism_explanation: An existentially selected start and finish delimit a shared ordering context for joint or separate occurrences.
concerns: The indefinite start is existential here; a generic universal interpretation would introduce another mechanism. Intermediate starts and finishes are allowed. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.

ambiguous_text: A pulse immediately followed by a flash and a click immediately followed by a mark must eventually occur.

readings.plain: The two two-step sequences have the same starting step.
readings.clear_rewrite: Eventually, a pulse and a click must occur at the same step, with a flash and a mark both occurring at the next step.

readings.plain: Each two-step sequence occurs, possibly starting at different steps.
readings.ltl: F(a & X b) & F(c & X d)
readings.clear_rewrite: A pulse immediately followed by a flash must occur at least once, and a click immediately followed by a mark must occur at least once; the sequences may start at different steps.

mechanism_explanation: Joint versus separate occurrence applies to composite ordered events.
concerns: The long coordination may favor independent sequences, and a joint reading needs human plausibility review. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.

ambiguous_text: The signal and the indicator must keep being active for two consecutive steps.

readings.plain: There are infinitely many starting steps for a common two-step active episode.
readings.clear_rewrite: Infinitely often, both the signal and indicator must be active at a step and both must also be active at the next step.

readings.plain: Each has infinitely many two-step active episodes, with no required alignment.
readings.ltl: G F(a & X a) & G F(b & X b)
readings.clear_rewrite: The signal must have two consecutive active steps infinitely often, and so must the indicator; their episodes need not align.

mechanism_explanation: The coincidence requirement recurs over sustained episodes rather than instantaneous events or one-time episodes.
concerns: Keep being active may suggest ongoing activity rather than recurrent episodes; continuous activity is permitted by both formulas. Formulas, reading plausibility, and rewrite clarity remain unverified.
